mechanism: Furosemide causes electrolyte depletion and volume depletion that may potentiate sympathomimetic effects of lisdexamfetamine, increasing cardiovascular stress and arrhythmia risk; lisdexamfetamine may reduce diuretic efficacy through sympathomimetic-induced vasoconstriction.
action: Monitor blood pressure, heart rate, and serum electrolytes (particularly potassium) regularly; consider alternative diuretics if possible and ensure adequate hydration and electrolyte supplementation.
